blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Camera (visionOS 26 + iOS 26 Camera spatial): Centered live passthrough viewfinder over true world blur (saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light), not synthetic gradient. Top bar hides until gaze — only two pills visible at rest: Grid subtle 28r and Flash Auto 11/700 with 0.06 outline, countdown off is text-only not pill, aspect 4:3 tucked in sheet not top bar. Viewfinder ~68% stage height with 20r glass, center reticle is 1px hairline 56 square with micro-dot and soft glow, never 64px heavy box. Bottom meta is single pill: AF f/1.8 1/120 tabular 10/600 with live green dot, not two. Controls below viewfinder breathe: segmented Photo/Video pill 30h with spring 260ms prism-ease interruptible, hint is single phrase 10/600 0.08em uppercase dimmed 0.42 until gaze near shutter, not all-caps SWIPE..., shutter is 78-80 white circle with 0.14 outer ring + soft accent bloom 16px that persists at rest as single focal point (others dim to 0.42), recent is single 44 peek thumbnail corner stacked, not full 4-thumb strip 76x56. Motion 220-280ms prism-ease, countdown is 72 tabular with blur wipe 260ms, flash is 160ms full-white veil with haptic, all interruptible by look-away reverse 180ms. Typography 3 sizes max: status 11/700 0.04em ink-60, viewfinder pills 11/600, hint 10, shutter label hidden (icon-only). Edge states are native sheets over passthrough with one 64 illustration + one CTA. At arm's length <1s glance: viewfinder -> shutter -> done.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Camera (Quest 3 Horizon Home / Camera app v74): Flat opaque panel #1e1e1e 12r, 1px #333 border, shadow 8px, no backdrop-filter. Viewfinder is 320x240 centered with dark grey fill #2a2a2a and flat mountain icon, no world gradient bloom. Top bar is 44h header Camera 16/700 + right battery 82% 12/600 with 1px divider, pills are flat grey 28r 11/600 with 1px stroke no blur. Inside viewfinder, controls are crowded: 4 pills Off 4:3 Grid Auto all same grey 27x28 flat, bottom two pills AF 12MP and f/1.8 1/120 with flat dot, reticle is hard 2px white box no glow. Below viewfinder: Photo/Video pill 30h flat grey with blue active flat no gradient, hint SWIPE... 10/600 but cramped, shutter is grey circle 68 with hard border, thumb preview 44 flat, flip icon flat, recents is 4 flat cards 80x60 full opacity with no glass. Motion linear 350-500ms slide, flash is abrupt opacity 0->1 400ms linear not interruptible, countdown is centered white 48px with linear scale 400ms bounce, grid fade 400ms linear. Edge states: empty is centered text No captures 16/600 with no illustration, loading is spinner + Loading... 14/500 centered, error is red text Something wrong + Retry flat grey, offline is snackbar Offline queuing overlapping strip, permission is system dialog opaque with Allow/Not now. No tabular numerals beyond time, SF stack but 4 equal weights, hints compete. Glance needs ~2.8s.

biggestGap: Focus discipline — exactly one obvious focal element per moment, gaze states unmistakable: expected visionOS single hero shutter 72-78 with persistent 16px accent bloom and neighbors dimmed to 0.42, plus one reticle hairline 1px 56 with soft glow, others hidden until gaze; viewfinder dominates, recents is single 44 peek. Got components/07-camera/index.html:157-821 viewport at rest reviews/07/stage.png shows 10 competing foci — top 4 chips Off 11/700 (28h 999r rgba0,0,0 0.42) + 4:3 + Grid + Auto equal weight, plus 2 bottom pills AF|12MP + F/1.8|1/120 10/600, plus modeSwitch Photo/Video 28h, plus hint SWIPE..., plus shutterRow left thumb 44 red gradient + LAST 10/700 + 8:14, plus center shutter 72 white, plus right flip 38, plus strip 4 thumbs 76x56 all same mat-glass blur8 + 0.12 stroke. No dimming, shutter halo opacity0 at rest (only gaze-focus scale1.05 opacity1, verified evaluate shutterHalo opacity0 default), reticle is heavy 64x64 12r 1px 0.22 with protruding ticks. Probe focusableInStage 17 vs ideal 3-4, sweep gaze left no persistent focus. Result glance needs ~2.2s not <1s, focus discipline fails harsh.
